confidence_note: Feedback and gulf of evaluation are the book's concepts (Wikipedia). The Three Mile Island indicator detail comes from accident summaries, and that Norman was called in comes from an interview; that the book itself uses this indicator as its feedback case is not verified, so the link is stated as a reading. 'Anxiety machines' from the old text was rejected.
facts: Feedback means full and continuous information about the results of actions; visibility means users can see the device's state and options.
Seven stages of action: goal, intention, specifying, executing, then perceiving, interpreting and comparing the outcome with the goal.
The gulf of evaluation is the effort needed to read the system's state and judge whether the goal was met.
The book gives a VCR whose recording needs several steps beyond pressing Record.
At Three Mile Island in March 1979 the indicator for the relief valve was wired to the valve's solenoid, so it showed a close command had been sent, not that the valve was shut.
A downstream temperature indicator could have hinted at the stuck valve but operators were not trained to look for it.
Norman has said he was called in with other psychologists to help retrain the operators.
scene_details: A light on a control panel that goes dark.
A relief valve that stayed open.
A VCR with several steps after Record.
tension: A light that told operators a command was sent, not what the valve did.
opening_idea: Open on the panel light going dark.

lessons.idea: Show the result of an action, not only that it was sent.
lessons.anchor: The indicator wired to the solenoid.

reflect_final: Where in your work or home does a signal tell you something was sent without telling you whether it worked?

use_cases.situation: A team sends a notice nobody confirms
use_cases.move: The Three Mile Island light showed a command, not the result; let's add a line that confirms it arrived.

use_cases.situation: Asking a family member to do something
use_cases.move: Ask them to tell you when it is done, not only that they heard.

use_cases.situation: A device that gives no sign
use_cases.move: Look for the result, not the click.

pocket_idea: A light that says a command was sent is not a light that says it worked.

conversation_variants.punchline_idea: The light only showed the command, not the valve.
conversation_variants.thirty_sec_idea: The panel light, Norman's definition of feedback, the gulf of evaluation.
